# i-Expert Chandrapur

> i-Expert is an iPhone and Android phone repair shop on Kasturba Road, near Pataleshwar Mandir, opposite Bharat Petroleum, Bazar Ward, Chandrapur 442402, Maharashtra, India. It replaces front glass and displays, back glass, batteries and charging ports, and inspects water-damaged phones. Customers book on WhatsApp (+91 98227 74003) and get a price before they visit.

## Key facts

- Name: i-Expert Chandrapur (also "i-Expert")
- Type: Mobile phone repair shop — iPhone is the main work; Android also repaired
- Address: Kasturba Road, near Pataleshwar Mandir, opposite Bharat Petroleum, Bazar Ward, Chandrapur 442402, Maharashtra, India
- Landmarks: near Pataleshwar Mandir, opposite Bharat Petroleum
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98227 74003
- Hours: Open daily — confirm today's timing on WhatsApp
- Languages spoken: English, Hindi, Marathi
- Brands: iPhone, Samsung, OnePlus, Vivo, Oppo, Xiaomi, Realme and others
- Google listing (reviews, directions): https://share.google/Hse1YJZSvR1mBke1q
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iexpert_chandrapur/ (@iexpert_chandrapur)

## Repairs

- Front glass and display replacement (cracked glass, lines, dead touch, black patches) — usually same day
- iPhone back glass replacement, without replacing the whole body; cameras and wireless charging checked after — usually same day
- Battery replacement (fast drain, shutting off at 20%, swollen battery) — usually same day
- Charging port repair or cleaning (loose cable, slow or no charging) — usually same day
- Water damage — inspected first; the shop says honestly what can be saved

## How booking works

1. Send the phone model and a photo of the damage on WhatsApp.
2. The shop replies with the part, price and timing before the visit.
3. Drop the phone at the shop on Kasturba Road (back up photos first if possible).
4. Pick it up after touch, camera, Face ID and charging are tested.

## Pricing

Prices depend on the model and the part. The shop quotes on WhatsApp from a photo before the customer visits; no price list is published.
